text:
releasebot: Deploy request queued: hotfix/kv-leak-fix -> canary. Window 03:00-03:10 UTC. Reason: spike in embed workers causing 503s. tagging @oncall SRE.

maya: acked — I'm oncall for that window. can we get expedited approval to skip extended canary if burn-in passes? :hourglass_flowing_sand:

jonas: +1 from eng-release. We need image pinned to sha: abc123def. If canary latency < 120ms and error rate < 0.5% after 2 minutes, allow fastcut.

devon: FYI, the change is just a kv-cache TTL bump and a small race fix. no model changes. rolling rollout is fine but we need the ability to abort and pin previous image quickly.

maya: understood. ops checklist:
```
- deploybot run --env=canary --image=redwood/hotfix:abc123def
- healthcheck /healthz 60s x 3
- monitors: embeddings-p99, kv-cache-errors
- rollback cmd: deploybot rollback --to-sha=prev-sha
```

sre_alex: I'll open the temporary alert channel and set SLO hold. If error-rate > 1% or p99 > 300ms revert immediately. Also adding a temporary traffic-silo to keep EU traffic on stable.

jonas: documenting release notes (short): "hotfix: fix kv cache race causing intermittent 503s on heavy embed workloads; pins image abc123def; TTL adjustments."

maya: opsbot, run preflight checks.

opsbot: preflight results: cluster quotas OK, infra health OK, image exists, no pending migrations. All checks passed.

devon: approving expedited path. Agree to skip prolonged canary if burn-in is green for 2 minutes. :thumbsup:

jonas: approving as release owner.

maya: @releasebot you have consensus — proceed when ready.

releasebot: Deployment started to canary (hotfix/kv-leak-fix @ sha abc123def). Notifying #incidents and creating ephemeral audit.

sre_alex: watching. will call abort if thresholds breached.

opsbot: canary health: minute 1: errors 0.2%, p99 95ms. minute 2: errors 0.1%, p99 102ms. Burn-in green.

maya: starting fastcut to 20% prod traffic. pinned image applied.

devon: rolling window open. release notes link: https://docs.internal/releases/1724680000-hotfix-kv-leak

jonas: thanks team. once stable we'll finalize release note and close the thread.

releasebot: Fastcut complete to 20%. Monitoring for 10m.

maya: temp channel cleared in 10m if stable. closing for now. :white_check_mark:
